enchantments.tooltip: Greater Marksmanship: This item is enchanted to enhance your skill with ranged weapons. You gain a +3 Competence Bonus to Ranged Attack and a +2 Competence Bonus to Ranged Damage.
Insightful Doubleshot 5%: Passive: 5% Insight bonus to Doubleshot. (Doubleshot is a chance to score an additional hit with a ranged attack.)

Feat: Wind Through The Trees: When enemies hit or miss you, they have a 5% chance to be knocked down with no save. This may only trigger once every 12 seconds, and shares a cooldown with the Wind through the Trees feat.

Greater Shrieking Bolt: This item resonates with sonic energy. On ranged attacks, on an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit it will punish the target with a blast of sound (20 to 120 sonic damage).
Deception +11: +11 Enhancement bonus to hit and +17 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
